promotion_criteria: Cost-complete metrics include actual deal profit, commission, swap and fee; real-tick spread is not charged twice.
At least 30 fully closed locked-OOS positions; otherwise the OOS result is inconclusive.
Locked-OOS net expectancy is positive and profit factor exceeds 1.0 after recorded costs.
The declared +2-point spread widening and +1-point per-fill slippage stress has positive expectancy or is explicitly recorded as a robustness failure.
HTF trailing ON has no stop-safety, stop-modification, duplicate-fill, restart-recovery or broker-ledger reconciliation failures.
Native MT5 tick-level equity drawdown remains under the project’s frozen risk limit; closed-position drawdown alone is insufficient.
No promotion based only on compile/CI, in-sample results, or Monte Carlo; demo-forward validation remains required.
